column4: componentize-py is not installed on this runner, and these tests need a real Python guest: they assert that a registered defer does not run at a sleep suspension and runs exactly once at a continue-as-new (cleat#4194, #4197), which only running one can show. They run and pass where componentize-py is installed (the engine test-go job and Cross-Language E2E).
